posts.title: How to Burn Tokens Without Burning Out
posts.description: Agents run at full speed, and so did I. This is how I slowed my sessions, my notifications and my nights down without giving up the results.

posts.title: Compound engineering is our factory floor
posts.description: A ten-person team's agents run on one plugin: humans own the plan and the review, agents the rest. In one October week we merged 469 PRs.

posts.title: Orders get obedience. Questions get opinions.
posts.description: I don't tell the model what to do. I ask it, because an order caps the answer at what I already knew, and a question leaves room to be wrong.
